name: FIT TO RUN 2026 – Leg 3
short_description: FIT TO RUN 2026 – Leg 3 is on Sunday 8 November 2026 at Clark Parade Grounds in Angeles City, Pampanga, over 5 km, 10 km, 16 km, 21 km and 32 km.

faqs.question: When is FIT TO RUN 2026 – Leg 3 taking place?
faqs.answer: FIT TO RUN 2026 – Leg 3 is scheduled to take place on November 8, 2026. The event will be held at the Clark Parade Grounds located in Angeles City, Pampanga, in the Philippines, offering runners a full day of races across several distance categories.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The organiser, SMOKE10 Events, lists five distances for Leg 3: 32 km, 21 km, 16 km, 10 km and 5 km. The 21 km is the half marathon; there is no full marathon at this leg, and the 32 km is the longest race on the day.

faqs.question: Who is organizing FIT TO RUN 2026 – Leg 3?
faqs.answer: FIT TO RUN 2026 – Leg 3 is organized by SMOKE10 Events. The event is being held in Angeles City, Pampanga, Philippines, at the Clark Parade Grounds, and includes multiple race distances scheduled for November 8, 2026.
